title: TransferBatch: deployed test-order verification
recordType: Curated summary of existing deployment QA records; not a new verification run
environment: Deployed Shopify app connected to a real development store with a zero-cost test subscription

observations.hashComparison: All downloaded output files matched their recorded issued SHA-256 hashes.
observations.reprintCancellation: A separate reprint reserved 12 copies; cancellation released the reservation without changing the original issued 12 copies.
observations.webhookExercise: A temporary order-tag change and reversal were processed on the permanent host.

limitations: Downloading a production file does not establish that it was physically printed.
The test establishes one software workflow, not paid customer adoption or broad production reliability.
Commercial distribution, operated recovery, and other release work remain pending.
Customer, account, and infrastructure identifiers are intentionally omitted from this public summary.
